title: Watermark
paragraphs: It’s a back alley. I’m casting a spell to flush out and burn any hidden assassins from the Three Heroes Church. Since I’ve already explained this to the Queen, there’s no chance of any of her faction’s shadows hiding. Well, after that, Father negotiated with the monster merchant for business purposes.
“However, I’m surprised that a hero is interested in slaves. Yes.”
“As the Shield Hero, there’s no way I can get comrades in this country, right? I’ll use whatever I can,” he responded sharply, knowing that backing down here wasn’t an option.
This is exactly how Father negotiated in the previous loop.
“Naofumi-san looks surprisingly good at bargaining.”
“Yeah, it’s like his usual carefree, sloppy expression is a lie.”
Ren and Itsuki are completely in spectator mode, watching Father. This is where Father proves reliable.
“However… hasn’t the Queen already ordered the slaves to be freed? Isn’t this a wasted effort?”
“There’s still a fair bit of confusion within the country. It’s also about asking this slave trader to look for people from that village.”
“Yes. That’s what Mother instructed. Since there’s no such thing as a registry, identifying them takes time.”
Oh, Fiancée is adding supplementary information.
“Mother also said she would like a description of any physical characteristics you can remember.”
“Wasn’t there the daughter of the person who managed that land?”

“Knight Éclair-sama values martial arts and etiquette more than administration, so while she may remember the people in her territory, it’s assumed that she’s not very familiar with Raphtalia-san and Rifana-san’s village.”
“I see…”
“If possible, if this Sadeena person the Spear Hero mentioned is around, it would help us identify them faster…”
“We don’t know her whereabouts.”
“As it stands, our country can only focus on gathering information.”
“I see… Ideally, we’d gather the slaves while steadily leveling up.”
“But unfortunately, there’s an activation event going on.”
Ren and Itsuki exchange troubled nods.
“Under Mother’s orders, surprise inspections of noble estates are planned to uncover abused slaves. Therefore, it’s recommended that the heroes grow stronger quickly.”
“Ah, so the Queen understood what happened when Motoyasu and I went on that rescue mission.”
“Yes. It’s believed that the nobles in our country are hiding similar facilities for abusive purposes.”
“They’re rotten to the core.”
Hmm… should I purchase a Filolial here? I can probably get Kuro-chan now. What should I do? I’m conflicted. For now, I’ll nudge Fiancée’s shoulder.
“Would it be okay to buy some Filolials here?”
“Ah, yes… a few should be fine.”
The problem is that bringing too many might cause issues.
“Then I’ll ask the monster merchant later.”
Buying Kuro-chan would definitely not be a waste. It’s better to quickly purchase Yuki-chan and the others afterward.
“Hm? What’s this?”
Ren and Itsuki noticed the monster lottery in the corner of the tent.
“Ah, that’s the monster egg lottery. Father used it to buy Filolial eggs both in the previous and the loop before that.”
“Oh…”
At that moment, one of the monster merchant’s subordinates subtly signaled to ask what to do. Ren and Itsuki aren’t participating, but they’re peeking in out of curiosity. Shall I take a look too?
Hmm… if I recall correctly, Luna-chan’s egg should be here. I should be able to identify it by scent, but I can’t find it. Maybe it hasn’t been stocked yet?
“Buying monster eggs through a lottery, huh?”
“If you buy ten, you’re guaranteed to get a winning egg from this special box. Yes.”
The monster merchant’s subordinate explained to Ren and Itsuki.
“Wait… I think I’ve seen this online before.”
“This is totally a gacha. And the illegal kind…”
“A complete-the-set type?”
Ren and Itsuki look at the egg lottery with a bit of exasperation. But they quickly composed themselves.
“It’s not like only Filolials can be allies. It might be fine to consider taming other pets.”
“True. We don’t know how strong they’ll be, but it’s not necessarily a bad idea.”
“Well, if we have the resources, we can consider it. It looks interesting.”
Luna-chan… where are you? Oh? I smell a familiar scent. I’m really tempted to get it, but having too many might be a problem.
“Motoyasu-san is sniffing the eggs intently…”
“Can he tell the difference?”
Fiancée looks puzzled. Of course, I can tell.
“It’s because he’s looping.”

Ren and Itsuki, looking disinterested, turned their backs. At this point, I should stick to the usual plan and buy Yuki-chan and the others. And just then, the spear twitched slightly… and one of the eggs in the lottery box began to glow with a red pattern. T-This is… I sense something extremely unpleasant from this egg. Casually, I picked up the glowing egg.
“U-Um? Would you like to give it a try?”

The monster merchant’s subordinate was staring intently at the egg I had picked up. This is…! I pressed the money I had on hand into the subordinate’s palm. Of course, this is the money I received from the Queen. Would about 25 gold coins be enough?
“I’ll be taking this, but please don’t make a fuss about it, okay? Report it to the monster merchant over there later.”
“U-Understood… but that egg is…”
“I know what it is, and I’m keeping it quiet.”
I released a bit of killing intent to intimidate the monster merchant’s subordinate.
“Y-Yes. Understood.”

In the end, it’s going to be a profit for the monster merchant, so they probably won’t pursue this matter too deeply. I casually glanced over at Father, Ren, Itsuki, and the others. Hm? It feels like the friend of the Big Sis was looking over here, but I’ll just ignore it. I quickly hid the egg in my pocket.
“You were planning to jack up the price and sell a fake, weren’t you? I won’t let that happen.”

“What!? We pride ourselves on our trustworthiness. Yes. Since the Wave hit Melromarc, there are new slaves who were captured. If we search among them, we should be able to find the ones you’re looking for. Of course, the price will increase depending on the buyback amount. What would you like to do?”
“Then, silver coins…”
Well, Father seems to have finished negotiating with the monster merchant. As always, his skill is impressive.
“Now, it’s time for the Filolials!”
“Yeah.”
Father stepped aside, and I approached the monster merchant.
“Filo-tan.”
“Huh?”
“Motoyasu-kun?”
Oops, I let it slip without thinking.
“Is Motoyasu’s head really okay?”
“He does act suspiciously sometimes. Could it be a side effect of looping?”
“He’s not saying anything wrong, so we have no choice but to trust him, but let’s stay on guard.”
I could hear Ren and Itsuki chatting in the background.
“I want a Filolial egg.”

So, I checked the Filolial eggs prepared by the monster merchant. Hmm… they’re all the same ones I met in the previous loop. Oh, it looks like Kuro-chan’s egg is still available. Alright, I’ll secure it.
“Thank you very much. We’ll be expecting your visit tomorrow.”
After finishing our negotiations, we left the monster merchant’s tent.
“With this, we should be able to gather a decent number, right?”
“Yeah, I think so.”

The Big Sis and her friend seemed a little frightened. Well, considering their experience as slaves, it’s probably stirring up some trauma. But worrying about that won’t get us anywhere. By tomorrow, Keel and some of the other slaves should have gathered to some extent, right? That’s what Father gently told the Big Sis and her friend, reassuring them.
